text:
maria: Heads up — starting a controlled rollout for catalog model rwd-titan-1.2. Plan: 10% global traffic canary for 2 hours, then 50% for 4 hours if metrics look good. Fallback ordering will be: rwd-titan-1.2 -> rwd-titan-1.1 (full float) -> rwd-titan-1.1-quant. Pinning: enterprise customers on enterprise-plan will remain pinned to rwd-titan-1.1 unless they opt in.

kevin: LGTM. What metrics are we watching for the canary? latency, token cost, and hallucination rate on eval set?

maria: yes — p95 latency, tokens/sec cost delta, and the regression test suite on the prompt set (eval-suite/canary_prompts). Alert thresholds in the runbook: p95 +20% or hallucination regression >3% triggers rollback. Also watching error rate and memory OOMs.

deploy-bot: deploy-started rwd-catalog-rollout-1753447200 by maria

ajay: adding routing config snippet for ops:

```
{
  "model": "rwd-titan-1.2",
  "traffic_split": {"canary": 0.10, "stable": 0.90},
  "fallback_order": ["rwd-titan-1.2","rwd-titan-1.1","rwd-titan-1.1-quant"],
  "pinned_customers": {"enterprise-plan": "rwd-titan-1.1"}
}
```

sophie: Quick note: rwd-titan-1.2 uses the new attention kernel; infra has GPUs queued on eu-west-1. We should restrict canary to us-east-1 and eu-west-1 only to avoid cross-region anomalies.

maria: good catch. updating plan: canary regions = [us-east-1, eu-west-1]. Also enabling KV-prefix caching for repeated chat contexts to reduce per-token cost during canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-step complete: routing config applied to catalog service (regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1) — 10% traffic split active

kevin: Metrics dashboard link: https://console.redwood/infer/dashboards/canary/1753447200

maria: baseline checks at t+10m: p95 latency +3%, cost per token +1.2%, hallucination delta -0.5% (improvement). No errors. Proceeding to monitor for full 2h.

ajay: recording release notes draft:
- Model: rwd-titan-1.2
- Changes: attention kernel optimizations; improved summarization on long contexts
- Canary: 10% (us-east-1, eu-west-1)
- Fallbacks: rwd-titan-1.1 -> rwd-titan-1.1-quant
- Pinning: enterprise-plan locked to rwd-titan-1.1

sophie: flag: quant variant rwd-titan-1.1-quant has slightly different tokenizer behavior for emoji sequences — need to watch chat tests.

maria: noted. added chat-emoji test to canary eval set.

deploy-bot: alert: canary-monitoring detected hallucination_regression = 3.6% at t+1h25m. Auto-escalation triggered.

kevin: seeing the same on the eval dashboard. Let's pause rollout. Maria — do you want an immediate rollback to rwd-titan-1.1 for the affected traffic slice?

maria: yes — pause traffic expansion and roll back canary to rwd-titan-1.1 for all regions. Keep logs and traces for investigation. We'll open a postmortem if root cause not obvious.

deploy-bot: rollback-started rwd-catalog-rollout-1753447200 by maria

ajay: command I ran to pin routing back:

```
rls routing set --model rwd-titan-1.1 --scope catalog --traffic 100%
```

deploy-bot: rollback-complete. catalog traffic now pinned to rwd-titan-1.1. Incident ticket created: INC-2025-0427 (assigned to eng-ml).

sophie: assigning to @elaine for model quality review and @zack for kernel compatibility. I'll add relevant eval logs.

maria: thanks everyone. Action items:
- eng-ml: triage hallucination regression on rwd-titan-1.2 (elaine)
- infra: check kernel perf/cold starts in eu-west-1 (zack)
- product: update release notes to indicate rollback and reason (maria)
- devex: hold public catalog announcement until fix

kevin: moving this to 'release-blockers' board and adding timeline notes. We'll attempt a narrower patch canary once fixes land.

deploy-bot: thread archived: rwd-catalog-rollout-1753447200
